category: IP geolocation API and database download

free_tier.stated: Free API: IP to country, state and city, limited to 500 requests a day with no key; IP to City Lite, IP to Country Lite and IP to ASN Lite databases as monthly CSV and MMDB downloads with no account
free_tier.notes: the Lite downloads are not metered; the City Lite release of October 2026 has 7,786,864 records against 40,982,099 in the paid IP to Location database

per_object_cap.stated: the October 2026 City Lite CSV is listed at 660.7 MB and is served as an 85,827,400-byte gzip; the MMDB is listed at 121.1 MB

interface_detail: free API: GET api.db-ip.com/v2/free/{ip} with no key, JSON; Lite files at download.db-ip.com/free/dbip-{city,country,asn}-lite-YYYY-MM.{csv,mmdb}.gz, served with no account and honouring HTTP range requests
tooling: any HTTP client; any MMDB reader for the MMDB files
chaining: anonymous on both paths: the monthly City Lite file serves unmetered local lookups and the free API covers 500 remote lookups a day; DB-IP Lite is also redistributed by the ip-location-db project on GitHub. Bulk path: the monthly Lite downloads
binding_note: the API meter of 500 a day is the only limit; the Lite files are unmetered but monthly and less accurate than the paid data

identity_cost.detail: no account and no key for the free API or the Lite downloads; the download page asks only to accept the licensing terms

reliability_note: Lite data is updated monthly and has reduced coverage and accuracy (accuracy index 77 against 96 for the paid database)
confidence_note: the free API page and the Lite download pages were quoted on 2026-10-30; a keyless API lookup answered HTTP 200 with city data and a ranged read of the City Lite CSV answered HTTP 206 with no account. The 500-a-day API meter was not exhausted to observe it.

evidence.proved: the free API maps IP to country, state and city and is limited to 500 requests a day
evidence.quote: The Free API is a fast and easy way to implement IP geolocation in a prototype or small website. It provides a simple IP to country, state and city mapping and is limited to 500 daily requests.

evidence.proved: City Lite is monthly, CSV and MMDB
evidence.quote: Our IP to City Lite database is updated monthly and available in CSV and MMDB formats.

evidence.proved: a web application links back to DB-IP.com
evidence.quote: In the case of a web application, you must include a link back to DB-IP.com on pages that display or use results from the database.
